source.title: Newry Telegraph, 6 June 1964, p. 1 ("The Rural Elections"); Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, pp. 6-7 ("Little Change after Fifteen Contests"); nominations from the Newry Reporter, 21 May 1964, p. 1 ("Great Interest in Rural Elections"); Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, p. 6 ("Newry No. 2 Rural District: Notice of result of elections, 1964", the returning officer's notice)
source.publisher: Newry Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every figure read from the page images; the returning officer's notice prints 'Feehan, Gerard' (175) and 'Liggett, Joseph' (149).

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1964: sixteen contests at the close of nominations, fifteen after the withdrawal of Bernard Murphy in Belleek, polled 4 June 1964. Polled 4 June 1964, counted 5 June. "Gain from Unionist": the sitting member, Joseph Brown, did not stand.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, p. 6 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the returning officer's notice of result names the winner 'Feehan, Gerard', so the newspaper's 'Feighan' (kept in Name_As_Printed) is recorded as Gerard Feehan; the notice was added to the citation.
